description: The Markiezenhof street front fills a small square on Steenbergsestraat in Bergen op Zoom. The long facade is brick with horizontal bands of white stone, red iron window baskets, stepped gables, and a slate roof. An octagonal stair tower with a spire stands at the left, beside a Tudor-arched gate. The sky is partly cloudy, about 17.7°C, with wind near 10.1 km/h. This is not the Grote Markt and not the Peperbus.
